settings.title: Generation settings
settings.modelHint: Changing the model applies its recommended steps and CFG.
settings.seedHint: Leave the seed blank to choose one automatically each time.
settings.historyHint: Uses recent requests and the selected image prompts as context. Set to 0 to omit history. Older requests are removed first if space is limited.
settings.reasoningHint: The reasoning budget is what remains after reserving 512 output tokens for the final prompt and a 128-token buffer. A higher output limit allows more reasoning. At 640 tokens or fewer, prompt writing starts without reasoning.
settings.contextHint: The context includes both input and output. The output limit also includes reasoning tokens. A larger context uses more GPU memory.
